title: 5 free GitHub repos for Claude Code video pipelines
prompt_text:
Whisper: transcribe raw.mp4 with a timestamp on every word
video-use: edit these takes into one video, show me every cut first
HyperFrames: build a 20-second promo as plain HTML, then render it
Remotion: turn this script into React scenes with my brand colors
OpenMontage: research this topic, write the script, then build the video

title: video-shotcraft: promo videos drawn in code with Remotion
prompt_text: Make a promo video for my product (agent skill: video-shotcraft; captures the product page, builds a storyboard from 124 shot cards, renders with Remotion)
